# Console reference

<!-- Generated by `cvar_markdown`; regenerate from build/bin with `./k -dedicated +cvar_markdown ../../docs/reference/cvars.md +quit` -->

Flags: **archive** saved to config.cfg, **cheat** needs `sv_cheats 1`, **replicated** server value sent to clients, **notify** changes are announced.

## Variables

| Name | Default | Flags | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cl_forwardspeed` | `450` | archive, cheat | Forward/back move speed. |
| `cl_interp` | `0.1` | archive | How far in the past other entities are drawn (seconds). |
| `cl_interpolate` | `1` |  | Smooth movement between server ticks. |
| `cl_pitchdown` | `89` | cheat | Max look-down angle. |
| `cl_pitchspeed` | `225` |  | Keyboard look speed (+lookup/+lookdown), degrees/sec. |
| `cl_pitchup` | `89` | cheat | Max look-up angle. |
| `cl_predict` | `1` |  | Predict your own movement. |
| `cl_showerror` | `0` |  | Log prediction errors. |
| `cl_showfps` | `0` | archive | Show frame rate. |
| `cl_showpos` | `0` | archive | Show player position and velocity. |
| `cl_sidespeed` | `450` | archive, cheat | Strafe speed. |
| `cl_smoothtime` | `0.1` |  | Seconds to smooth out prediction errors. |
| `cl_upspeed` | `320` | archive, cheat | Up/down speed (noclip, swimming). |
| `cl_yawspeed` | `210` |  | Keyboard turn speed (+left/+right), degrees/sec. |
| `crosshair` | `1` | archive | Draw a crosshair. |
| `developer_io` | `0` |  | Log every entity I/O event as it fires. |
| `fov_desired` | `90` | archive | Field of view (horizontal degrees at 4:3). |
| `fps_max` | `300` | archive | Frame rate limit (0 = unlimited). |
| `host_maxticks` | `0` | dev | Quit after this many server ticks (0 = never). For automated tests. |
| `host_timescale` | `1` | cheat, replicated | Game speed multiplier. |
| `hostport` | `27015` |  | UDP port the server listens on. |
| `hud_draw` | `1` | archive | Draw the HUD. |
| `m_pitch` | `0.022` | archive | Mouse pitch factor (negative inverts). |
| `m_yaw` | `0.022` | archive | Mouse yaw factor. |
| `mat_anisotropy` | `8` | archive | Anisotropic filtering level (applies to newly loaded textures). |
| `mat_antialias` | `4` | archive | MSAA samples (0, 2, 4 or 8). |
| `mat_exposure` | `1` | cheat | Tonemapping exposure. |
| `mat_fullbright` | `0` | cheat | Disable lighting. |
| `mat_showmissing` | `1` |  | Log a warning for each missing material. |
| `mat_tonemap` | `1` |  | 0 = clamp, 1 = ACES filmic. |
| `mat_vsync` | `1` | archive | Wait for vertical sync. |
| `mat_wireframe` | `0` | cheat | Draw the world in wireframe. |
| `name` | `player` | archive | Your player name. |
| `net_fakelag` | `0` | cheat | Delay outgoing packets by this many ms (testing). |
| `net_fakeloss` | `0` | cheat | Drop this percentage of outgoing packets (testing). |
| `net_graph` | `0` | archive | Show network stats (ping, loss, bandwidth, prediction). |
| `r_decals` | `128` | archive | Maximum impact decals. |
| `r_drawaxis` | `0` | cheat | Draw the world origin axes. |
| `r_drawbrushmodels` | `1` | cheat | Draw brush entities. |
| `r_drawprops` | `1` | cheat | Draw props. |
| `r_drawsky` | `1` | cheat | Draw the skybox. |
| `r_drawworld` | `1` | cheat | Draw world geometry. |
| `r_farz` | `16384` | cheat | Far clip plane distance. |
| `r_fog` | `1` |  | Distance fog. |
| `r_fogdensity` | `0.00018` |  | Fog density. |
| `r_lockpvs` | `0` | cheat | Freeze the PVS at the current leaf, then fly around to inspect it. |
| `r_nearz` | `4` | cheat | Near clip plane distance. |
| `r_nofrustum` | `0` | cheat | Disable frustum culling of leaves. |
| `r_novis` | `0` | cheat | Ignore the PVS (draw every leaf in the frustum). |
| `r_particles` | `1` | archive | Draw particles. |
| `r_shader_hotreload` | `1` | archive | Recompile shaders automatically when their files change. |
| `r_showbounds` | `0` | cheat | Draw bounding boxes around props. |
| `r_skyname` | `sky_day` |  | Sky cubemap name (materials/skybox/<name>_px.png ...). |
| `sensitivity` | `3` | archive | Mouse sensitivity. |
| `snd_mute` | `0` | archive | Mute all sound. |
| `snd_show` | `0` |  | Log every sound as it plays. |
| `sv_accelerate` | `10` | replicated, notify | Ground acceleration. |
| `sv_airaccelerate` | `10` | replicated, notify | Air acceleration. |
| `sv_autobunnyhopping` | `0` | replicated, notify | Holding jump re-jumps on landing. |
| `sv_cheats` | `0` | replicated, notify | Allow cheat commands and cvars. |
| `sv_falldamage` | `1` | notify | Players take damage from long falls. |
| `sv_friction` | `4` | replicated, notify | World friction. |
| `sv_gravity` | `800` | replicated, notify | World gravity. |
| `sv_hitscan_damage` | `25` | notify | Damage per hitscan hit. |
| `sv_lagcompensation` | `1` |  | Rewind players to what the shooter saw. |
| `sv_listen` | `1` | archive | Let other players join games you start with 'map'. |
| `sv_maxplayers` | `8` |  | Maximum connected players. |
| `sv_maxspeed` | `320` | replicated, notify | Maximum player speed. |
| `sv_noclipaccelerate` | `5` | archive, replicated | Noclip acceleration. |
| `sv_noclipspeed` | `5` | archive, replicated | Noclip speed multiplier. |
| `sv_password` | `` |  | Password required to join (empty = none). |
| `sv_respawntime` | `3` | notify | Seconds before a dead player respawns. |
| `sv_stepsize` | `18` | replicated, notify | Maximum step-up height. |
| `sv_stopspeed` | `100` | replicated, notify | Minimum stopping speed on ground. |
| `sv_tickrate` | `66` |  | Server simulation rate (ticks/sec). Applied on map load. |
| `volume` | `0.8` | archive | Master volume (0-1). |

## Commands

| Name | Flags | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `alias` |  | Create a command alias: alias <name> "<commands>". |
| `bind` |  | Bind a key to a command: bind <key> "<command>". |
| `connect` |  | Join a server. |
| `cvar_markdown` |  | Write every cvar and command as a Markdown table: cvar_markdown <file>. |
| `cvarlist` |  | List all commands and cvars (optionally only those starting with a prefix). |
| `debug_clear` |  | Remove all debug lines. |
| `debug_drawcross` | cheat | Draw a debug cross for a while. |
| `debug_drawline` | cheat | Draw a debug line for a while. |
| `disconnect` |  | Leave the current game. |
| `echo` |  | Print text to the console. |
| `ent_fire` | cheat | Send an input to entities: ent_fire <target> <input> [param]. |
| `exec` |  | Run a config file from cfg/. |
| `exit` |  | Exit the engine. |
| `find` |  | Find commands and cvars whose name or help contains a string. |
| `getpos` |  | Print setpos/setang commands for the current position. |
| `help` |  | Show help text for a command or cvar. |
| `host_writeconfig` |  | Save binds and archived cvars to cfg/config.cfg. |
| `incrementvar` |  | incrementvar <cvar> <min> <max> <delta>: step a cvar, wrapping around. |
| `key_listboundkeys` |  | List all key bindings. |
| `kill` |  | Kill yourself (respawn). |
| `map` |  | Start a local server on a map. |
| `maps` |  | List available maps. |
| `mat_reloadall` |  | Reload all textures and materials from disk. |
| `menu` |  | Show/hide the main menu. |
| `noclip` |  | Toggle flying through walls (needs sv_cheats 1). |
| `play` |  | Play a sound script at your position. |
| `quit` |  | Exit the engine. |
| `r_reloadshaders` |  | Recompile shaders from disk. |
| `screenshot` |  | Save a PNG screenshot to screenshots/. |
| `setang` | cheat | Set the view angles. |
| `setpos` | cheat | Move the player to a position (feet). |
| `status` |  | Show the server and connection status. |
| `toggle` |  | Toggle a cvar between 0/1, or cycle: toggle <cvar> [values...]. |
| `toggleconsole` |  | Show/hide the console. |
| `unbind` |  | Remove a key binding. |
| `unbindall` |  | Remove all key bindings. |
| `wait` |  | Pause the command buffer for N frames (default 1). |

## Buttons

Held while a key is down (`+name` on press, `-name` on release): `+attack` `+attack2` `+back` `+duck` `+forward` `+jump` `+left` `+lookdown` `+lookup` `+movedown` `+moveleft` `+moveright` `+moveup` `+reload` `+right` `+speed` `+use` `+walk`
